structured_output.what_is_happening: "Cream" is a 12-minute-old token. It was not launched on the pump.fun curve: a PumpSwap pool was created about 24 seconds after the mint, with $155k of liquidity against an $88k market cap. All of the LP is unlocked and there are few LP providers. About $1.1M has traded in roughly 13 minutes, which is 6x+ turnover. The last 5 minutes are down 3–6% after an earlier +22–30% move, and ATH is about 11% above the current price. GMGN tags 41 bundler wallets. The creator holds nothing, and GMGN reports the creator status as 'creator_close'. The linked X item is a post by cremieuxrecueil, not a project account. A same-name Cream token created about 3.4 hours earlier is already at $683k market cap, so this one looks like a late copy.

narrative.description: A 'Cream' meme apparently tied to a post by the X personality Cremieux (cremieuxrecueil). At least 10 same-name copies launched within minutes of each other about 3.4 hours ago, so the story is being farmed.
narrative.why_spreading: A post from a known X personality set off a wave of copy launches. The leading copy already holds most of the attention and price discovery.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, and it links the same X post. Nothing makes it canonical: it launched hours after the leader and was deployed by a creator with no history.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CMuvWQ6q... Cream: $683k mcap, $88k liquidity, $447k h1 volume, about 3.4h older, so the likely canonical. Around 9 other dead Cream/CREAM/CREAMCOIN copies.

authenticity.evidence: Liquidity is larger than market cap on a self-seeded, unlocked PumpSwap pool. There are 41 bundler wallets. $1.1M of volume on an $88k cap in 13 minutes. 226 unique buyers against only 41 unique sellers, but about 740 buys and 558 sells, which fits repeated bot cycling. The creator wallet is closed and there is no project profile or socials. The 'website' is a usepaid.app link.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 226 unique buyers could include some real followers of the Cremieux post. GMGN reports bot_degen_rate as 0.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked on a dev-seeded PumpSwap pool, so the liquidity can be pulled at any moment
Liquidity is above market cap, which is an unusual setup typical of LP-pull traps
Creator wallet closed with no track record
Late copy of a ticker that already has a clear leader
GeckoTerminal shows 98% of supply in the top 10 including the pool

structured_output.counterargument: Liquidity is deep relative to market cap, so volume can move price. Real buyers (226 unique) are coming in from a live Cremieux meme. The top-10 wallets outside the pool hold only 8.5%, with no single large holder. If the leading copy keeps running, rotation could push the cheaper copy toward 2x ($176k), a level the leader already passed easily.
unknowns: Whether the $683k leader is still rising or already fading
How real the 226 unique buyers are
What the Cremieux post was actually about

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical copy of the Cream meme sitting on a self-seeded, fully unlocked LP, with heavy bundling and wash-like turnover. The likeliest outcomes are an LP pull or a fade. The chance of a clean 2x before a -50% move is low.
